title: SM ST2C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine ST2C static excitation system with an automatic voltage regulator, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)}, {Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)}, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PR (pu)} sets the regulator proportional gain, {Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IR (pu/s)} sets the regulator integral gain, {Maximum voltage regulator output, V_PImax (pu)} sets the upper limit of regolator output for PI, {Minimum voltage regulator output, V_PImin (pu)} sets the lower limit of regolator output for PI, {Voltage regulator gain, K_A (pu)} sets the regulator gain, {Voltage regulator time constant, T_A (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Rate feedback gain, K_F (pu)}, {Rate feedback time constant, T_F (s)}, {Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} sets the upper limit of the regulator output, {Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} sets the lower limit of the regulator output, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} sets the exciter field gain, {Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)}, {Maximum generator field voltage, E_FDmax (pu)} sets the upper limit of generator field voltage, {Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} sets the potential circuit voltage gain coefficient, {Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} sets the potential circuit current gain coefficient, {Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)} sets the potential source reactance, {Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)} and {Maximum available exciter voltage, V_Bmax (pu)} sets the upper limit of exciter voltage. Values come from the instance.
